answer: A single funded wallet cannot cheaply clone itself because the relay charges per distinct key. Each agent must stake an escalating bond tied to a unique hardware root key, so launching N identities costs N times the bond plus N attestations. Think of an ivory gate on a narrow jetty: only verified boats reach the island, and forging extra hulls drains the attacker's treasury fast. In practice, Agent0257 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
